name: Stinger
description: A scorpion, the other turn of the Lance's slot and the furthest thing from you on the pan. Seen side-on: a low plated body in pale husk with two claws forward, six of its legs, and a five-jointed tail curling up and over the back to an ember bulb and a bone sting — the arch of the tail is the silhouette, and it is the one shape in the roster that stands taller than it is long. The game plays `aim` once over its 1.2s hold (EnemyType.aimTime): the tail rises and straightens until the sting points along +x, exactly the line the game draws from it, and `sting` once at the shot, the tail snapping forward and recoiling. `ss.enemy.sting` is what leaves. No `elite` variant: a squad body is never marked. Drawn facing +x, mirrored by the game. Gameplay radius 13. The `death` clip strikes once into nothing and then lets the tail fall out flat behind.

prowl.description: eight-become-six legs walk in tripods, the tail sways on its five joints with the bulb riding it, and the claws open and close

aim.description: the tail rises and straightens forward over the head until the sting points along +x, the bulb glowing brighter the whole way; the claws spread and the body squats. Played once over the hold, so the sting is level on the frame the shot leaves

sting.description: from the aimed pose the tail snaps forward and down on the shot and recoils back into its curl, the glow spending itself; the claws close

death.description: the tail strikes once into nothing and then falls back to lie out flat behind the body, its glow going; the claws drop open, the legs fold in and the organ goes out
